# @tansy/analytics-umami

Umami for @tansy/analytics: the tracker on every page, and its numbers on the dashboard.

```bash
npm install @tansy/analytics-umami
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the analytics plugin documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/plugins/analytics.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
